mechanism: PUMP-ACTION SPIRAL SHAFT (canon): the twisted central rod is a classic pump-top mechanism. Papa grips the shaft and pumps it down three or four times — each push accelerates the striped body — then releases and steps back. The BODY with the two seats spins around the shaft like a carousel around its center pole; riders hold their own grab-handles and spin with the body. SH025's sharp wind-up plays as sharp pumps with a rising vzh-VZH sound build.
